# What each client offers

What each Briareus client offers, feature by feature, against the server API (/api/v1). Support is full, partial, none, or n/a (the platform cannot, not merely does not). Audited from each client's code on 2026-11-21 (briareus-windows 70d3404, briareus-swift 385471c, briareus-android 84d2832, briareus-quest 28619fb) and against the server's /api/v1 at core c749e2a; update it in the same pull request that adds or removes a feature in a client.

● full · ◐ partial · `·` none · – n/a (the platform cannot)

| | Windows | Mac | iPhone/iPad | Android | Quest |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ● full | 75 | 89 | 67 | 33 | 28 |
| ◐ partial | 5 | 1 | 3 | 11 | 7 |
| · none | 28 | 18 | 38 | 64 | 73 |
| – n/a | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

## Connection & pairing

| Feature | Windows | Mac | iPhone/iPad | Android | Quest | Notes |
| --- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | --- |
| **Pair with a device token**<br>Connect to an HTTPS server with a per-device token kept in the OS secure store. Wireframe: [pairing](wireframes/pairing.svg) | ● | ● | ● | ● | ● | **iPhone/iPad:** CarPlay cannot pair; the phone does. |
| **Adapt to server and token**<br>Controls the server lacks, or the token may not call, are hidden or disabled (Read-only tokens can't write). Wireframe: [pairing](wireframes/pairing.svg), [project-pulls](wireframes/project-pulls.svg), [settings-projects](wireframes/settings-projects.svg) | ● | ● | ● | ● | ● | **Android:** Catalog re-read on launch; a permission or project change clears the cache. |
| **Revoke token from the app**<br>Revoke this device's token on the server, not just forget it locally. | · | · | ● | ● | ● | **Windows:** Sign-out forgets the token locally without revoking it on the server. **Mac:** Sign out is local only, and its message still points to web Settings, which no longer exists; tokens are revoked on the server with `npm run create-token -- --revoke`. revoke_token is in the core table but unused by the Mac UI. **Quest:** From the sidebar's settings menu. |
| **Saved state and incremental resume**<br>Screens open on cached projects, conversations and transcripts, then fetch only what changed. Wireframe: [project-pulls](wireframes/project-pulls.svg) | ● | ● | ● | ● | ● | **Android:** Encrypted on the device. **Quest:** Encrypted on the headset. |
| **Live session updates**<br>Session lists and transcripts update in real time over server-sent events. Wireframe: [project-pulls](wireframes/project-pulls.svg) | ◐ | ● | ● | ● | ● | **Windows:** Screens poll with backoff; GET /events is opened only by the sleep-mode wall, and /sessions/{id}/events is never used. **Mac:** Paused while offline (see Weak or lost connection). **iPhone/iPad:** Foreground only: iOS closes the streams in the background and they catch up on return; polling carries on where the server lacks them. |
| **Self-update**<br>Checks GitHub releases, verifies and installs updates. Wireframe: not drawn yet. | ● | ● | – | · | · | **iPhone/iPad:** Distributed via App Store/TestFlight. **Android:** Signed APKs on GitHub releases, no in-app updater; Android could install updates. **Quest:** Sideloaded APK with no updater; Android could install updates. |
| **Weak or lost connection**<br>Say when the app is offline or cannot reach the server and since when the screen was saved; pause or slow polling and streams on a poor link and read every screen again when it returns. | · | ● | ● | ◐ | ◐ | **Windows:** Polls with backoff; no offline notice. **iPhone/iPad:** Also slows polling in Low Data Mode. **Android:** Shows whether it is live, connecting or offline and reconnects with backoff; no saved-since notice. **Quest:** Shows whether it is live, connecting or offline and reconnects with backoff; no saved-since notice. |

## Retired features

Features the server or every client has dropped.

| Feature | Why |
| --- | --- |
| **Review loop toggle** | The server no longer has a per-session review loop toggle; core #228 removed it with the old code review system. |
| **Pull request babysitter** | Core #297 removed the pull request babysitter and its project setting. |
| **Findings queue** | Core #228 removed findings triage with the old code review system; stored code reviews replace it (see Code reviews & approvals). |
| **Triage a held round** | Core #228 removed held review rounds and their triage routes. |
| **Reply/delete on others' reviews** | Core #228 removed the findings reply and delete routes. |
| **Decide findings on a PR page** | Core #228 removed `POST /pulls/{number}/findings/decision`; a verdict is now overruled on a stored code review. |
| **Database pool** | Core #274 removed the session database server pool and `/settings/db-servers`. |
| **Meeting assistant** | Removed from Windows and the Mac in November 2026; no client offers it. |

## Server routes no client calls

- **pulls:** `GET /pulls/{number}/commits`, `GET /pulls/{number}/checks`, `GET /pulls/{number}/code-review-decisions`, `PATCH /pulls/{number}/code-review-decisions/{decisionId}`, `GET /pulls/{number}/approvals`
- **reviewBenchmarks:** `GET /review-benchmarks/cases`, `POST /review-benchmarks/cases`, `PUT /review-benchmarks/cases/{caseId}`, `POST /review-benchmarks/cases/{caseId}/retire`, `POST /review-benchmarks/cases/{caseId}/adjudications`, `GET /review-benchmarks/runs`, `POST /review-benchmarks/runs`, `GET /review-benchmarks/runs/{runId}`, `POST /review-benchmarks/runs/{runId}/cancel`, `PUT /review-benchmarks/runs/{runId}/results/{resultId}/judgments/{findingId}`, `DELETE /review-benchmarks/runs/{runId}/results/{resultId}/judgments/{findingId}`, `GET /review-benchmarks/compare`
- **reviewQuality:** `GET /review-quality`
- **session-files:** `POST /sessions/{id}/files`
- **sessions:** `POST /sessions/{id}/btw`, `POST /sessions/{id}/qa-loop`, `POST /sessions/{id}/link-pr`, `GET /sessions/{id}/preview`, `GET /sessions/{id}/alarms`, `POST /sessions/{id}/alarms`, `DELETE /sessions/{id}/alarms/{alarmId}` — Side questions, QA loop, linking a pull request, the preview record and session alarms.
- **whatsapp:** `GET /whatsapp/accounts`, `GET /whatsapp/accounts/{id}`, `POST /whatsapp/accounts/{id}/start`, `GET /whatsapp/accounts/{id}/qr`, `POST /whatsapp/accounts/{id}/logout`, `GET /whatsapp/accounts/{id}/conversations`, `GET /whatsapp/accounts/{id}/conversations/{chat}/messages`, `POST /whatsapp/accounts/{id}/conversations/{chat}/messages`, `POST /whatsapp/accounts/{id}/conversations/{chat}/read`, `GET /whatsapp/accounts/{id}/conversations/{chat}/messages/{message}/media` — The WhatsApp screens on Windows and the Mac embed web.whatsapp.com instead.
- **slack:** `GET /slack/workspaces`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations/{channel}`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/people`, `POST /slack/workspaces/{id}/direct-messages`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations/{channel}/messages`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations/{channel}/threads/{ts}`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/files/{file}`, `POST /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations/{channel}/messages`, `POST /slack/workspaces/{id}/conversations/{channel}/read`, `GET /slack/workspaces/{id}/events`, `GET /slack/requests`
- **deployments:** `GET /deployments/config`
- **envoyer:** `GET /envoyer/accounts/{id}/projects/{project}`, `GET /envoyer/accounts/{id}/projects/{project}/deployments/{deployment}`
- **settings.projects.backup:** `GET /settings/projects/{id}/backup`, `POST /settings/projects/{id}/backup`
- **settings:** `GET /settings/ci-rates`, `PUT /settings/ci-rates`
